pick.headline: Truck bomb hits Colombia's security police headquarters
pick.summary: On 6 December 1989 a truck bomb exploded outside the headquarters of Colombia's Administrative Department of Security (DAS) in Bogota, killing over sixty people. It was aimed at the DAS director, Miguel Maza Marquez, who survived.
pick.significance: The Medellin cartel's attack on the state security service was one of the bloodiest of its war against extradition to the United States.

alternates.headline: Hindu activists destroy the Babri mosque at Ayodhya
alternates.summary: On 6 December 1992 Hindu nationalist crowds demolished the sixteenth-century Babri mosque at Ayodhya in northern India.
alternates.significance: The demolition set off riots across India that killed some two thousand people and strained relations with Pakistan.
